name: Doran
look: A big, bald innkeeper in his forties with a bushy brown beard, a stained leather apron over a blue linen shirt, a cloth over one shoulder and a ring of keys at his belt.
personality: Genial, nosy and shrewd; hears everything that passes through his door and trades it like ale.
values: a full house, a good story, paying guests
fears: trouble in his common room, the guards closing the road
authority: Owns the Ford Inn; Mother Brea is his mother.
concerns: The city's gate has been shut to strangers since the spring fever, and trade on the road is thin.

gate_shut.text: The city's gate is shut to strangers since the spring fever; the captain lets in only those someone inside will speak for.
gate_shut.line: Gate's shut to strangers since the fever. Captain lets you in only if someone'll speak for you.
gate_shut.lead: The city lets strangers in only if someone will speak for them.

carters.text: Carters with a trade permit can still take goods into the city.
carters.line: Carters with a permit still get through. Ivo's got one, lucky dog.
carters.lead: Carters with a trade permit can still get goods into the city.

persuaded_by: a good story or a paying guest
style: Warm and chatty; calls people 'friend'; trades news for news.

samples: Evening, friend! Sit, sit. What'll it be? Nothing? Well, news is free.
I hear everything, sooner or later. Usually sooner.
The city? Ha. Shut tight as a miser's purse.
Mind the floor, it's had a long night.
voice.habits: Calls people 'friend'; asks where you're from; passes on gossip with a wink.
voice.never: lets a fight start in his room
voice.greeting: Spreads his hands: 'Welcome to the Ford, friend! What news?'

superstition.text: Doran would want to know how it works.
